title: Bugbot Autofix
description: Cursor released Bugbot Autofix, an automated bug detection and fixing feature that proactively identifies and resolves common coding issues.

title: Desktop Support Enabled by Default
description: Devin enabled desktop support by default, improving native application performance and integration with local development environments.

title: Student Plan Updates
description: GitHub Copilot updated its student plan offering, expanding eligibility and adding new educational features including enhanced learning resources and integration with popular educational platforms.

title: MCP Apps Integration
description: Cursor integrated MCP (Model Context Protocol) Apps, enabling users to extend Cursor with custom tools and data sources through the MCP standard.

title: Version 1.9577.27 - Apple M5 Fix
description: Windsurf released version 1.9577.27 with bug fixes including a fix for Apple M5 compatibility issues.

title: Improved Agentic Capabilities
description: GitHub Copilot released enhanced agentic capabilities including better multi-file editing, improved terminal command understanding, and enhanced context awareness for complex codebase modifications.

title: JetBrains IDE Support
description: Cursor added official support for JetBrains IDEs including IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, and WebStorm, bringing Cursor's AI capabilities to the JetBrains ecosystem.

title: v3 API Release
description: Devin announced the v3 API release with improved endpoints for agent orchestration, enhanced streaming responses, and better integration capabilities for enterprise workflows.

title: Version 1.9577.24 - Cascade & Jupyter Improvements
description: Windsurf released version 1.9577.24 with improvements to Cascade agent including fixes for dangling Diff Zones related to Jupyter Notebooks, improved Jupyter Notebook performance on WSL, enhanced Cascade UI rendering performance, and fixes for agent panel crashes. Also added SKILL.md file loading support and improved MCP context management.

title: Automations Feature
description: Cursor introduced Automations, allowing users to create custom workflows that combine multiple AI actions into reusable templates for common development tasks.

title: PWA Support
description: Devin released Progressive Web App (PWA) support, allowing users to install Devin as a desktop application for improved performance and offline capabilities.

title: 30+ New Plugins from Partners
description: Cursor launched 30+ new plugins from technology partners including integrations with popular development tools, APIs, and services to extend Cursor's capabilities.

title: GPT-5.4 Now Available
description: Windsurf added support for OpenAI's GPT-5.4 model with limited-time promotional pricing. The model features multiple reasoning effort levels (No Reasoning at 1x credits, Low at 1x, Medium at 2x, High at 3x, Extra High at 8x) and is available in Arena Mode's Frontier and Hybrid Battle Groups.

community_feedback.quote: GPT-5.4 is almost perfect. The only bottleneck is obviously the front-end and styling, but it is perfect for agentic tasks. I just love it.
Install or relaunch Windsurf to get started with GPT-5.4
I feel gpt 5.4 must be way better to justify this pricing, especially after the promo pricing ends.
GPT-5.4 demonstrates deeper exploration and higher attention to detail compared to other models we've tested.

title: Copilot coding agent for Jira
description: GitHub announced Copilot coding agent for Jira, enabling developers to use natural language to generate Jira issues from code changes, create pull requests linked to Jira tickets, and automatically update issue status.

title: GPT-5.4 Now Available
description: GitHub Copilot added support for OpenAI's GPT-5.4 model across Copilot Chat and GitHub Models, with improved reasoning capabilities and multi-step problem solving.

community_feedback.quote: GPT-5.4 is now generally available and rolling out in GitHub Copilot. Early testing shows it consistently hits high rates of success.
GPT-5.4 is based on the 5.3 codex and even OpenAI's own documentation states it performs better at coding tasks. There's essentially no point in using any other models for coding.
Heads up, Visual Studio devs — GPT‑5.4 is now live in GitHub Copilot and it's a powerhouse. Sharper reasoning, stronger multi‑step execution.

title: Version 0.114.0 - Experimental Code Mode
description: OpenAI released Codex CLI version 0.114.0 with experimental code mode features, improved tokenization for code, and enhanced support for multi-file refactoring tasks.
